name: org.thevalleydesk/directory
title: The Valley Desk
description: Search healthcare research connected to the nine-county Delaware Valley. Read-only.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search The Valley Desk directory of research software, publications and clinical studies connected to the nine-county Delaware Valley (Philadelphia region). Matches titles, topics, institutions and keywords. Every filter is optional. Returns up to 24 records per page with the site URL, the Verified or Listed evidence label and labelled dates.

query.description: Words to match, for example "sepsis prediction".

kind.description: Limit to software projects, publications or clinical studies.

institution.description: Institution name or id, for example "Drexel University". list_institutions returns the names.

topic.description: Topic name, for example "Medical imaging". list_topics_and_counties returns the names.

county.description: One of the nine Delaware Valley counties.

page.description: Page number. Each page holds up to 24 records.

label.description: Limit to one regional evidence label.

date_from.description: Earliest publication, last code push or study registry update date. YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

date_to.description: Latest published date or last code push. YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

added_from.description: Earliest date added to the directory. YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

added_to.description: Latest date added to the directory. YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

sort.description: added: newest directory additions first (default). date: newest published or pushed first. title: A to Z.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Get one publication, software project or clinical study by its directory id (from search or whats_new) or its thevalleydesk.org URL. Returns the regional connection and its source alongside kind-specific details.

id.description: Directory id such as "doi:10.1000/example" or "474026", or the record's thevalleydesk.org URL.

tools.name: whats_new
tools.description: List records added to The Valley Desk directory on or after a date, newest additions first. The date is when the record entered the directory, which can differ from when the research was published.

kind.description: Limit to software projects, publications or clinical studies.

institution.description: Institution name or id, for example "Drexel University". list_institutions returns the names.

topic.description: Topic name, for example "Medical imaging". list_topics_and_counties returns the names.

county.description: One of the nine Delaware Valley counties.

page.description: Page number. Each page holds up to 24 records.

tools.name: list_institutions
tools.description: List the regional institutions in The Valley Desk directory with the number of listings recorded for each. Use a returned name as the institution filter in search.

tools.name: list_topics_and_counties
tools.description: List the topics and the nine Delaware Valley counties in The Valley Desk directory with the number of listings recorded for each. Use a returned name as the topic or county filter in search.
